findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 22 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 55 questions numbered 1-55; by section: 22.1 9, 22.2 7, 22.3 8, 22.4 16, 22.5 4, 22.6 11.

Covers the introduction and sections 22.1-22.6.2 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals (heat of combustion, moles of H₂ and O₂) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: R in an alcohol is alkyl, 1,2-ethanediol/1,2,3-propanetriol, K₂Cr₂O₇ = potassium dichromate(VI), oxidation releases electrons in the breathalyser, MnO₄⁻, phenol made by warming the diazonium salt with water, 2 phenol + 2Na balanced, phenyl ethanoate is an ester.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
